vertex_uv_check_vs_SM_Extractor.note: vertices mapped back to the body frame (rotor offset added) and looked up in SM_Extractor.fbx within 0.02 cm; uv compared per corner within 1e-4; cap vertices carry the cap texel UV and are not compared

sweep.method: rotor rotated about its vertical axis every 10 degrees over 360 (36 angles); BVH triangle overlap between the rotor and the rest of the assembly (body and the other rotors); faces with a vertex on a cut surface (neck plane or prism plane: the planar contact of the caps and their rim) are excluded; minimum distance from vertices and face centres of each to the other; penetration = how far a rotor triangle pokes through the body triangle plane
